source_shapes.source: [NPC] Ryan: A Campfire Initiate Badge I, for our latest initiate, <username>!
source_shapes.translation: [NPC] Ryan: Значок посвящённого костра I — нашему новому посвящённому, <username>!
source_shapes.runtime_constraint: Preserve actual username and observed player-head component without expanding the global username guard.

source_shapes.source: [NPC] Ryan: Congrats! Your <old badge item name> was upgraded to a <new badge item name>!
source_shapes.translation: [NPC] Ryan: Поздравляю! Значок улучшен: <old badge item name> → <new badge item name>!
source_shapes.runtime_constraint: Closed known badge names/tiers only;do not accept arbitrary item or player text.

source_shapes.source: [NPC] Ryan: I need you to hold your <badge item name> so I can upgrade it!
source_shapes.translation: [NPC] Ryan: Возьми в руку «<badge item name>», чтобы я мог улучшить значок!
source_shapes.runtime_constraint: Copy current component and styles of the closed known badge name.

source_shapes.source: [NPC] Ryan: Next step is the Trial of Fire <tier>! (<amount> damage)
source_shapes.runtime_constraint: Validate Roman tier and bounded numeric damage separately;preserve both current components.

source_shapes.source: [NPC] Ryan: Try the Trial of Fire Trial <tier> for a greater challenge!
source_shapes.translation: [NPC] Ryan: Попробуй испытание огня <tier>, если хочешь задачу посложнее!
source_shapes.runtime_constraint: Closed valid published Trial of Fire tiers only.

scope: Five patterns, concrete variants are tests not separate translated queue entries. Canonical badge terminology follows catalogue.tsv.
